UI_trait_GarouDesc: You are Garou: a werewolf, kin to the wolf. <LINE> Rage builds as you suffer and as you kill, <LINE> and it buys you four other shapes: Near-Human, <LINE> the Berzerker war form, the Near-Wolf, and the Wolf. <LINE> Beast forms heal fast, purge the Knox virus from a bite, <LINE> carry in their jaws and cannot work a trigger or a tool. <LINE> Silver burns you, and a silver wound stops healing <LINE> until the burn is gone. <LINE> Fast Healer, Hearty Appetite and Cat's Eyes are included. <LINE> Pick your origin, coat and auspice on the Werewolf Startup panel.
